subject: Re: HealthScale trial — acceptance scenarios, evidence, and timeline
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@healthscale.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthscale.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthScale trial — need acceptance criteria + evidence checklist

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo — team loved the latency profile and routing options. We need a short, operational acceptance checklist so our SRE and procurement teams can greenlight a two-week trial. Two asks from our side:

1) A clear list of acceptance scenarios (functional + perf) with pass/fail thresholds we can run against our representative dataset.
2) A mapping of what evidence you will provide (logs, latency histograms, token-cost report, security questionnaire answers) and who on your team will own each evidence artifact.

Can you share a one-page MAP-style table plus a sample acceptance test file by EOD Thursday? Procurement copied for timing.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Data Platforms
HealthScale

--

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@healthscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthScale trial — need acceptance criteria + evidence checklist

Emma —

Thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP table (HS_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) and a short acceptance-test-cases.md with example checks you can run. Quick summary below so SRE/procurement can triage:

MAP highlights (one-line):
- Trial window: 2 weeks (start after onboarding sprint, recommended Tue start)
- Primary success signals: 95th pct latency <= 220ms, median latency <= 110ms, token concordance >= 92% on sample prompts, no PII leakage on sample redaction tests.
- Exit gates: critical perf breach (>2 consecutive days 95th > 400ms), data-safety failure (PII detection misses), or functional regression (>=10% drop in concordance vs baseline).

Acceptance evidence we will provide and owners:
- Latency histograms + percentile table (Mateo, runtime team)
- Token-level billing and estimate by workload (Karthik, pricing)
- Sample response concordance report (Marissa, solutions)
- Audit logs + trace IDs for failing tests (Mateo)
- Completed security questionnaire and SOC2 extract (security@redwood.com) — note these are in a sealed evidence packet; procurement, I can share a read-only link.

Sample test cases included: smoke prompt set (20 prompts), throughput ramp (1 -> 50 rps over 30m), PII redaction probe (synthetic PII injection), and fallback failover test (route to smaller model variant if capacity constrained). Each test has an expected pass threshold and an owner column in the MD file.

Next steps proposal:
1) You review the MAP draft and test cases.
2) We schedule a 30-minute alignment call to finalize owners and the trial start date (I can run staff onboarding).
3) Agree on an evidence-sharing location and access.

I'm available Thursday morning for the alignment call.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
SR Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: HS_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx, acceptance-test-cases.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@healthscale.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthScale trial — need acceptance criteria + evidence checklist

Emma, Mateo —

Thanks Mateo for the clear draft. A few operational clarifications from our side before the alignment call:

- Ownership: I'll own the concordance test validation and run one blind pass against the 20-prompt smoke set, with the HealthScale test owner included in the results digest.
- Availability: We can provision a dedicated trial capacity pool to guarantee isolation for the two-week window; delivery lead is Karthik.
- Evidence cadence: We'll publish daily latency/usage summaries to the shared Drive link and a final evidence zip at trial close. If procurement needs a signed commitment on retention/traceability, let us know — we can add a one-page addendum.

Suggested agenda for the 30-min call:
1) Confirm trial start date and who will run each test.
2) Walk the evidence artifacts and access controls.
3) Agree on rollback/failover behavior if the trial triggers an exit gate.

Emma — does 10:00 AM PT Thursday (tomorrow) work for you?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Marissa/Mateo —

Confirmed: 10:00 AM PT Thursday works (that's 2026-05-28). Procurement still needs the SOC2 extract and a short note about retention for logs — procurement@healthscale.com, can you confirm the minimum info you need?

We've reviewed the MAP draft and the acceptance-test-cases doc; for our SRE the only change request is to add an explicit golden baseline for concordance: we'll provide a 500‑record baseline file; can your team run the concordance calculation and include the diff summary in the final evidence packet? Also, please include the expected format/schema for the token-cost report (CSV with fields: timestamp, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd).

If you can drop an updated MAP with the baseline column and a sample CSV header by EOD Monday, procurement will prioritize the internal review. Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Data Platforms
HealthScale
